alerts.title: Abnormal Vital Signs
alerts.description: Patient presents shallow breathing. SpO2 dropped to 89%. Oxygen applied per protocol. Continuous monitoring required.

alerts.title: Telemetry Alert: Possible Fall
alerts.description: Wearable device detected a sudden movement consistent with a fall. Floor staff already notified. Resident is stable but requires assessment.

alerts.title: Medication Refusal
alerts.description: Resident refused to take morning dose of Losartan 50mg. Caregiver attempted twice. Requires follow-up by attending nurse.

alerts.title: High Blood Pressure Reading
alerts.description: Blood pressure recorded at 175/105 mmHg during routine check. Previous reading was within normal range. Medication review recommended.

alerts.title: Missed Therapy Session
alerts.description: Resident did not attend scheduled physical therapy at 10:00 AM. Room check confirmed he was awake. Reason unknown.

alerts.title: Confusion Episode Reported
alerts.description: Resident exhibited signs of confusion and disorientation at 07:30. Staff intervened and calmed her. Physician was notified.

alerts.title: Fall Incident
alerts.description: Resident fell in the bathroom at 06:20. No visible injuries detected. Neurological observation protocol initiated as precaution.

alerts.title: Low Blood Glucose Alert
alerts.description: IoT glucometer detected blood sugar at 58 mg/dL. Nursing staff provided juice and crackers. Will recheck in 30 minutes.

alerts.title: Medication Interaction Warning
alerts.description: Pharmacy system flagged potential interaction between newly prescribed Warfarin and existing Aspirin dose. Physician review required before administration.

alerts.title: Irregular Heart Rate Detected
alerts.description: Wearable monitor detected heart rate of 112 bpm for over 10 minutes. Resident reports feeling slightly dizzy. EKG requested.

alerts.title: Family Visit Restriction Request
alerts.description: Family member requested temporary visit restriction due to recent respiratory infection in the household. Documented and flagged for care team review.

alerts.title: Pressure Ulcer Stage 2 Detected
alerts.description: Care assistant identified stage 2 pressure ulcer on left heel during morning hygiene routine. Wound care protocol initiated. Physician notified.

alerts.title: SpO2 Stabilized - Follow-up
alerts.description: Follow-up check confirms SpO2 back to 95%. Oxygen therapy discontinued. Continue monitoring for 24 hours.

alerts.title: Refused Morning Meal
alerts.description: Resident refused breakfast for the second consecutive day. Nutritionist has been alerted. Possible appetite loss due to medication side effects.

alerts.title: Increased Agitation Observed
alerts.description: Resident displayed increased agitation and verbal aggression during lunch. Possible sundowning episode. Calm environment measures applied.
